subject: Phased commitment billing — PO stub, net terms ramp, and invoice cadence
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@mediglobal.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@mediglobal.com>
Date: 2027-06-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: PO template & billing cadence question for MG enterprise commitment

Karthik —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement asked me to share a couple of constraints so we can get an approved PO out the door: 

- We need a single PO number per legal entity (MediGlobal US / MediGlobal AZ) but will accept separate invoice lines per BU.
- Net terms: Finance prefers Net 60 from invoice date.
- Invoice cadence: they want monthly invoices for consumption, but quarterly settlement is also acceptable if we provide a monthly statement that ties back to the PO.
- PO stub: must include vendor remit-to (ACH details), Redwood tax ID, and a short description of deliverables per line item.

Can you confirm Redwood can accept an umbrella PO with per-entity references and issue monthly invoices that reconcile to a quarterly statement? Also any notes about applying the negotiated volume discount during the first billing period (they want the discount effective immediately on signing).

I have attached our standard PO template. Carlos is on finance and copied here — he will route for approval once we have vendor details filled in.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can move to legal.

— Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Sr. Procurement Manager, MediGlobal Health
Alicia.Gomez@mediglobal.com

--- Attachment: PO-template-MediGlobal.xlsx (xlsx)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@mediglobal.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@mediglobal.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-13T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO template & billing cadence question for MG enterprise commitment

Alicia —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can accept an umbrella PO with per-entity references; we can produce monthly invoices that roll up to a quarterly statement; and we can apply the negotiated volume discount prospectively from the signing date. Two important notes: 

1) Retro credits: if you require the discount to apply to earlier usage in the same month prior to execution, we can do a one-time retro credit on the first invoice. We prefer prospective discounts but will make an exception for the initial period for enterprise deals.

2) Net terms: standard hosted accounts are Net 45; Net 60 is an exception. I can route to finance but need finance sign-off (cc'ing Grace for that). If Finance approves Net 60, we also ask for an early pay contact and the remit-to entity mapping on the PO so we can match invoices automatically.

I attached the updated SOW (v2) with line-item descriptions that map to the PO structure. If MediGlobal can provide the exact legal entity names and BU codes you want on each invoice line, we will populate the PO fields and return a vendor-ready PO stub with our tax/ACH info.

Proposed next steps: 
- Karthik: fill vendor stub once you confirm legal names and remit-to mapping
- MediGlobal: confirm whether you want the discount applied immediately or as a retro credit on first invoice
- Finance (Grace): confirm Net 60 exception and any billing acceptance criteria

If that works I will also attach a DocuSign envelope for SOW signature after PO is in place.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

--- Attachment: SOW-MediGlobal-v2.pdf (pdf)

Karthik / team —

Finance has reviewed. We can approve Net 60 as an exception for MediGlobal provided the following are on the PO and received before first invoice: 

- Exact legal entity (as registered) that will be billed
- Entity BU code or cost center for each invoice line
- Remit-to details (ACH) and tax ID matching vendor stub (we will send vendor stub to Alicia once we have the legal names)
- A clause indicating billing is monthly with quarterly reconciliation (this helps our AR matching process)

Regarding the discount: we will allow Redwood to apply the volume discount prospectively from the signature date. If MediGlobal insists on the discount being applied to prior consumption in the month of signature, Redwood should issue a one-time retro credit and note it on the first invoice. We will accept that approach as a one-off.

Operational items for team: 
- Karthik: please capture MediGlobal legal names and BU codes in HubSpot (company record attached).
- Marissa: please prepare the vendor stub (tax ID, ACH, remit-to) and a short PO-fill template so Alicia can paste values into their template.

I'm OK with Net 60 and monthly invoices reconciling quarterly. Please confirm and share the populated PO template.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
